description: ONE CONTRIBUTOR TO A POOL, WITH ITS AMOUNT AND ITS ENTRY COUNT. What turns a pool from an assertion into a figure somebody can walk back to the ledger. `entry_count` matters as much as `amount`: a cost center that contributed $40,000 across two entries and one that contributed $40,000 across four hundred are different facts about the same number, and the first is usually a journal somebody should look at.

fields.description: The Cost Center or Account docname. Data rather than a Link, deliberately: a source that was renamed or removed after the pool was computed must still read back as what the figure was actually built from, and a broken Link would render as empty.
fields.label: Reference

fields.description: How many GL entries stand behind the amount. Zero on a Manual row, which is what a manual row honestly is.
fields.label: Entry Count

fields.description: How this contribution was measured, in words — the filter that was applied and the window it covered.
fields.label: Basis
